statement.p: (a) Find the distance from the point P_0 = (4,6,3) to the plane -4 x + 2 y + 3 z = -1. Use sqrt() to enter square roots.
(b) Find the equation of the plane that passes through the points P = (-4,2,-1), Q = (1,5,4), and R = (-3,-1,-1). Write your answer in terms of the variables x, y, z.
